anya (docs): Quick heads-up 9 — I pushed a tiny docs PR that harmonizes quota examples, updates the SDK header to X-RW-Usage, and adds a Grafana permalink. Draft: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/2734 :wave:

sam (eng-platform): Nice. Two really small asks: 1) make the canonical example hourly (billing match) and leave a 1m ops variant; 2) add a one-liner about burst credits appearing in the "available" metric (committed + burst).

anya (docs): Done. PR now shows hourly first and a labeled 1m snippet. Added: "Visible allocation = committed tier + burst credits; billing reconciles on UTC daily windows."

lia (devex): Also update the JS SDK snippet to the new header and show how body.series[].points is ordered. Tiny example OK.

anya (docs): Included this snippet: `const r=await fetch('/v1/usage?from=-1h&group_by=1h',{headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${process.env.RW_KEY}`,'X-RW-Usage':'project=acme'}});const b=await r.json();console.log(b.series[0].points.map(p=>p.value));`

sam (eng-platform): One more troubleshooting line: if totals double during canary->stable flips, check routing headers and unique meter_key per route. Add it under Troubleshooting.

anya (docs): Added troubleshooting note. Pushed edits, CI running.

deploy-bot: docs-ci started for PR #2734  build 1199 queued.

anya (docs): Will tag @sam and @lia once CI passes. :rocket:
